# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This knowledge base is distilled from 75+ audio recordings and transcripts of sales interactions, dealer inquiries, yard coordination, and customer negotiations at **BSC (Bharat Steel Group / Bharat Steel Chennai Private Limited)**. 

The calls capture daily trade operations run primarily by sales lead Varsha and the central desk, operating out of the head office and central processing yard at **Vichur / Thirunilai Village (near Manali / Ponneri Taluk, Chennai)**. Key sales workflows represented include spot quoting, technical grade clarification, cut-to-length (CTL) feasibility checks, transport/loading cost integration, test certificate (TC/MTC) matching, third-party inspection (UT testing) coordination, and strict 100% advance payment enforcement before truck dispatch.

---

## Products & Brand Ladder

BSC operates as a primary distributor and authorized stockist specializing in heavy structural steel, hot-rolled (HR) plates/coils, chequered plates, and primary TMT rebars.

```
                  PRIMARY STEEL BRANDS (MOU / Primary Yards)
         ┌───────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────┐
         │                           │                           │
       SAIL                        VIZAG                       NMDC
 (Steel Authority of India)    (RINL / VSP)            (National Mineral Dev. Corp.)
  - Plates, Channels, Beams    - Heavy Structurals      - High-grade HR Plates / Coils
  - Premium brand acceptance   - Channels, Angles       - Government make / SAIL-merged heritage
         │                           │                           │
         └───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────┘
                                     │
                                    JSW
                        (Chequered Plates / Coils)
                                     │
                     ─────────────────────────────────
                     SECONDARY / RE-ROLLING (Selective)
                     - Local rolling: Commercial angles (40x6),
                       light channels (only when primary rolling dry)
```

### 1. Hot Rolled (HR) Plates & Coils (CTL Processing)
* **Grades Handled:** IS 2062 **E250 BR** (standard structural) and **E350 BR** (high-tensile). E450 available on special indent.
* **Grades NOT Handled / Clarified Out:** E350C / E350CR (Charpy V-notch impact tested at sub-zero), S355JR, ASTM A516 Gr 70, EN series, HRPO (Pickled & Oiled).
* **Thickness Spectrum:**
  * Light / Medium: 2.0 mm, 2.8 mm, 3.0 mm, 4.0 mm, 4.8 mm, 5.0 mm, 6.0 mm, 8.0 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, 14 mm, 16 mm.
  * Heavy Plate: 20 mm, 25 mm, 30 mm, 32 mm, up to 80 mm (against indent/Posco/JSPL cut pieces).
* **Standard Plate Dimensions:** Widths: 1,250 mm / 1,500 mm / 2,000 mm / 2,500 mm. Lengths: 2,500 mm, 5,000 mm, 6,300 mm, 12,000 mm, 12,500 mm.

### 2. Chequered Plates
* **Make:** JSW / Primary.
* **Thickness & Sizes:** 4.0 mm, 5.0 mm, 6.0 mm in standard $1,250 \times 2,500\text{ mm}$ ($8 \times 4\text{ ft}$) and $1,250 \times 6,300\text{ mm}$.
* *Note:* 3.0 mm chequered plate is unavailable in the primary market.

### 3. Structural Steel (Beams, Channels, Angles)
* **Channels (ISMC):** $100 \times 50$, $125 \times 65$, $150 \times 75$, $200 \times 75$, $250 \times 80 / 82\text{ mm}$.
  * *Critical Stock Note:* $75 \times 40\text{ mm}$ channel experiences persistent 3–4 month rolling dry spells across SAIL/Vizag. Non-standard sizes like $175 \times 75\text{ mm}$ are not rolled.
* **Beams & Columns (NPB / WBP / Joists):** NPB 200, NPB 300 ($36\text{ kg/m}$), NPB 350 ($50\text{ kg/m}$ & $57\text{ kg/m}$), NPB 400, NPB 450, WBP $300 \times 300$ ($117\text{ kg/m}$), ISMB 250, Joist 150.
* **Equal & Unequal Angles (ISA):** $50 \times 50 \times 6$, $60 \times 60 \times 6$, $65 \times 65 \times 6$, $75 \times 75$, $90 \times 90 \times 8$, $110 \times 110 \times 12\text{ mm}$. (Sizes $\le 40 \times 40\text{ mm}$ come only in commercial re-rolling).

### 4. TMT Rebars & Exclusions
* **TMT Rebars:** 10 mm, 12 mm, 16 mm in SAIL / Vizag (Supplied as Straight Rods or U-Bent / Bend Rods).
* **Non-Stocked Items (Refer to Sister Concerns / Market Outsourcing):**
  * Decking / Roofing Sheets $\rightarrow$ Redirect to sister entity **Crayon Roofing and Structures**.
  * Hollow Sections (RHS/SHS/Round Pipes), Square Bars, Bright Bars $\rightarrow$ Direct to trade retail.
